text:
𝗞𝗢𝗟𝗞𝗔𝗧𝗔 𝟮𝟬𝟬𝟭: 𝗧𝗛𝗘 𝗚𝗥𝗘𝗔𝗧 𝗖𝗢𝗠𝗘𝗕𝗔𝗖𝗞 🔥

Laxman 281 and Dravid 180 shared a 376-run stand after India followed on.
India beat Australia by 171 runs, ending their run of 16 straight Test wins. 🇮🇳

#Cricket #VVSLaxman

facebook.caption:
𝗞𝗼𝗹𝗸𝗮𝘁𝗮 𝟮𝟬𝟬𝟭 – 𝗧𝗲𝘀𝘁 𝗰𝗿𝗶𝗰𝗸𝗲𝘁 𝗸𝗮 𝘀𝗮𝗯𝘀𝗲 𝗯𝗮𝗱𝗮 𝗰𝗼𝗺𝗲𝗯𝗮𝗰𝗸! 🔥

👉 Follow-on ke baad Laxman ke 281 aur Dravid ke 180
👉 Dono ke beech 376 run ki partnership
👉 India ne Australia ko 171 run se haraya, unki 16 jeet ki lakeer tod di
